form.label: Nginx / Apache HTTP Access/Error - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage dashboard for Nginx/Apache access-log and selected error-log sourcetypes. This is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:common" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ | stats count
index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:common" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ status=4* | stats count
index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:common" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ status=5* | stats count

index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:common" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ http_method=POST | stats count

index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:common" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ | timechart count by sourcetype

index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:common" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ status=* | stats count by status | sort -count | head 20

index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:common" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ | stats count, values(status) as statuses, values(http_method) as methods by src_ip, uri_path | sort -count | head 50

index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:common" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ http_method=* status=* | chart count over http_method by status

index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:common" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ (status=4* OR status=5*) | table _time host sourcetype src_ip user http_method uri_path status bytes_out http_referrer http_user_agent signature_id | sort -_time | head 100
index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ | stats count by http_referrer, http_user_agent | sort -count | head 50

index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:common" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ | stats count, dc(src_ip) as client_count, values(vendor_product) as vendor_product by host, source, sourcetype | sort -count | head 100

index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:access:combined" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:common" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:access:combined") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype src_ip user http_method uri_path status bytes bytes_out marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:error" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:error") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype vendor product error_level module error_code process_id tid connection_id src_ip client_port server host_header request error_message http_referrer marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100
index=netops (sourcetype="nginx:error" OR sourcetype="apache:httpd:error") host=$host_tok$ src_ip=$src_tok$ | stats count by sourcetype, error_level, module | sort -count | head 20
